findings.title: On an on/off pump, the switch path switches off steps whose planned heat the plan books as delivered
findings.claim: The solver treats a step below the modulation floor as duty cycling within the step (bounds [0,P_max], optimizer.py ~:3962). The switch path instead commands ON only at max(0.1, min_electrical_power*0.5) (HeatPumpOptimizer._power_to_heat_pump_schedule and get_current_action; pump_arbiter._on_kw uses the same threshold). On an on/off pump (min==max==6 kW, which config_flow._power_errors accepts) the threshold is 3 kW, so the plan's 1.0-1.4 kW trickle is switched OFF while the trajectory, cost and savings count that heat as delivered. On/off arm: 4/9 cells withhold more than 10% of planned energy. Shoulder withholds 0.671 (8.30 of 12.38 kWh over 30 steps), producing 30 end-to-end switch.turn_off calls on steps with planned heat. Modulating null arm: 0/9 cells (max 0.014) and 0 such calls. Shoulder open-loop consequence: min room 20.64 C planned vs 19.89 C actuated, 17.2 K*h below the plan's own trajectory, 0 K*h below min_temperature.

evidence.value: onoff_failing_cells=4 (LOO 3) of 9; modulating_failing_cells=0; onoff_e2e_turn_off_with_planned_heat=30; shoulder withheld_frac=0.671
evidence.machine: box B7 cloud container, Linux 6.18, 4 vCPU, numpy/OpenBLAS

perturbation.change: --perturb: patch HeatPumpOptimizer._power_to_heat_pump_schedule in memory to a 0.1 kW on-threshold (its own floor) instead of min_electrical_power*0.5. Alternatively --min 1.0 (a modulating floor) on the on/off arm.

findings.metric_definition: withheld_frac = planned space+DHW kWh in steps whose production heat_pump_on_schedule is False, divided by the plan's total planned kWh; a cell fails above 0.10; e2e counts switch.turn_off calls from _apply_action on steps with planned power > 0.1 kW
findings.phenomenon_property: Every seam that decides whether the pump runs a plan step must agree with the solver's reading of a sub-floor step as duty cycling. A step with planned heat must not be actuated OFF.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Make the on/off decision consistent with the plan for sub-floor steps. Either the threshold stops withholding planned heat (ON when a step carries planned heat, letting the pump's own thermostat duty-cycle), or the solver is constrained to bang-bang or the floor when min==max. The seams listed by the rule change together.

findings.title: The pump-duty arbiter writes the operating mode with select.select_option whatever domain the mode slot holds
findings.claim: topology.ASSIGNABLE_KEYS['heat_pump_mode_entity'] accepts select, sensor and input_select, and config_flow has no check tying pump_duty_mode=control to a writable domain. pump_arbiter._write still hard-codes ('select','select_option'), the defect #1526 fixed for the switch slot via coordinator._on_off_service. Under control with an input_select mode slot, 5 of 5 mode writes are routed to a domain with no such entity. The mode is wrong on all 9 arbitration ticks, and the pump_write_ignored repair tells the user the pump does not hold a write that never reached it, retried every 5 min. A sensor (enum) slot fails the same way. Null control, a select slot: 0 misrouted, 0 wrong ticks, no repair.

findings.title: On an on/off pump every full-power step publishes as 'eco' and power_normalized runs to -60
findings.claim: get_current_action computes p_norm = (P - min)/max(max - min, 0.1). When min==max the 0.1 kW divisor floor turns a degenerate range into a x10 scale. A full-power 6 kW step gets p_norm 0, so HeatPumpActionSensor.native_value is 'eco' rather than 'boost', and idle steps publish power_normalized = -60. On/off arm: 149 full-power steps mislabelled across 7/9 cells (range 0-31, LOO 118); power_normalized minimum -60.0. Modulating null arm: 0 mislabelled; minimum -0.2, which is the same formula on every install and goes as a lead. The climate hvac_action is unaffected because it also reads heat_pump_on.

evidence.machine: box B7 cloud container, Linux 6.18, 4 vCPU, numpy/OpenBLAS

perturbation.change: --min 5.0: the on/off arm's min_electrical_power becomes 5.0 kW (a 1 kW modulation range). One-line production alternative: guard p_range==0 in get_current_action instead of max(p_range, 0.1).

findings.metric_definition: full_power_mislabelled = plan steps with planned space power >= 0.99*max_electrical_power whose published HeatPumpActionSensor state is not 'boost', summed over 9 golden cells
findings.phenomenon_property: The published action band and power_normalized stay in [0,1] and rank a full-power step at the top on every compressor kind, including min==max.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: get_current_action handles a zero modulation range (an on/off pump is either off or at 1.0) and clamps power_normalized to [0,1].

findings.title: sysid two-state fit rolls the candidate with one Euler step per 30-min sample: UA 17-25% low on an exact continuous plant, 0/3 presets adopt
findings.claim: On a noise-free truth plant with exactly the declared preset parameters integrated finely (30 substeps per 30-min sample), the production identify_slab fit returns UA -16.8% (light_new) and -25.5% (heavy_old) and refuses typical_slab, so 3 of 3 presets are biased >5% or refused and 0 of 3 are adopted; with the truth integrated at the fit's own 0.5 h Euler step the bias is 0.0 and 2 of 3 adopt.
findings.mechanism: _simulate_slab_path -> _valve_drive -> ThermalModel.simulate_step(dt_hours=sample interval) is one explicit-Euler step of 0.5 h per sample; the fit identifies the parameters of the 0.5 h Euler map, not of the continuous house (and not of the optimizer's own 0.25 h step: truth at 2 substeps gives -8.9/-10.9/-23.3%). The biased fit's residual flattens the profile, so the #1410 gate refuses it as 'interval unbounded' and the published heat_loss_kw_per_c carries the biased value.

evidence.contention_note: fan-out, up to 3 finders on the box; deterministic noise-free count, contention-immune

findings.title: _current_spot_price reads a quarter up to 45 min stale under 15-minute price entries
findings.claim: With 15-minute price entries (what the default Tibber QUARTER_HOURLY pull returns), HeatPumpOptimizerCoordinator._current_spot_price returns the earliest entry that started within the last hour instead of the entry covering now. It is wrong on 28..42 of 96 quarters per day when prices ramp within the hour, and on 12..18 of 96 when prices are constant within each hour (the three quarters after every price change). The published current_price, the settlement's price/spot_price, sysid's price and the comfort learner's relative price all read it.

evidence.unit: quarters of 96 mispriced per non-flat profile (ramp arm); step arm 12..18; mean |err| 0.042..0.584 per kWh, mean 0.185, leave-max-out 0.105

perturbation.change: In _current_spot_price, replace the entry span timedelta(hours=1) with 15 minutes (the harness does this in memory with --perturb)
perturbation.expected_direction: The quarter-entry arms fall to 0 mismatches and the hourly-entries null control rises from 0 to 273. The span is the mechanism; an honest fix takes each entry's end from the next entry's start, as _known_prices_for does, and must read 0 on all three arms.

findings.metric_definition: Per profile, the count of the 96 quarters (clock frozen 7 minutes into each) where _current_spot_price() differs from the price of the entry whose [start, start+15 min) contains now; keyed on the value the seam returns.
findings.phenomenon_property: Every seam that prices 'now' from the price entry list must use each entry's real span, taken from the entries, and not a fixed one-hour span.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Make _current_spot_price look up the covering entry the way _known_prices_for does (bisect on the sorted starts; the end is the next start), or call _known_prices_for([now]) directly. Add a features.py pin with quarter entries at :07 past each quarter.

findings.title: PV piecewise cost clipped by import_margin's zero floor wherever import price < export price
findings.claim: pv.import_margin floors (import - export) at zero, so wherever import < export on a surplus step, HeatPumpOptimizer._energy_cost_fn and pv.blended_block_prices price surplus-covered energy at the import price instead of the export compensation it forgoes. This breaks the stated identity export·min(P,s)+import·max(P−s,0) on 16 of 96 steps for summer_negative at the shipped default export price 0.0. On a real solve the published predicted_cost is −0.609 where the identity gives 0.000, and the plan draws 5.07 kWh from surplus in negative-price steps against 2.27 kWh unfloored.

evidence.unit: steps of 96 breaching the piecewise identity (summer_negative, export 0.0 default); summer_typical @0.30 = 20; signed error per day at 3 kW, export 0.30: range −5.04..0, mean −1.14, leave-most-negative-out −0.36; solve predicted_cost − identity = −0.609
evidence.contention_note: light seat; counts and currency identities are contention-immune
evidence.tolerance: exact for counts; ±1e-6 for the solve's currency figure

perturbation.change: Remove the zero floor in pv.import_margin, returning import − export unclipped (the harness does this in memory with --perturb via mock.patch.object)
perturbation.expected_direction: Breach steps fall to 0 in every cell, the solve's predicted_cost − identity goes from −0.609 to 0.000, and surplus kWh in negative-price steps goes from 5.07 to 2.27.

findings.metric_definition: Per (price profile, export price) cell, the count of the 96 steps where the production cost closure's price of a 3 kW single-step draw differs by more than 1e-9 from export·min(P,s)+import·max(P−s,0)·dt with a clear-sky 6 kWp surplus; keyed on the closure's returned value.
findings.phenomenon_property: Every PV-aware pricing seam must charge surplus-covered energy at the export compensation for any sign of import − export; no seam may floor the margin.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Drop the clip in pv.import_margin, or replace it with a guard only on non-finite values. findings.title: Climate entity is permanently unavailable on an install without an indoor thermometer, taking the thermostat control with it
findings.claim: HeatPumpOptimizerClimate.available is False in every cell whose indoor thermometer has not read, even though the coordinator holds a fresh payload. Its hvac_mode, target, presets and 22 payload-backed attributes are therefore never published, and HA's service calls skip the entity, while current_temperature already returns None without a reading.
findings.mechanism: climate.py available ANDs in coordinator.data['reading_ok']['upper_floor_temperature']. That flag is False for an unconfigured indoor entity (coordinator._reading_ok), and the README (line 168) and the config_flow (vol.Optional) both make that entity optional. The A3(e) aim, not publishing the 21.0 constructor default, is already met by current_temperature returning None. The whole-entity gate is redundant for that aim and removes the control surface: HA's entity_service_call skips unavailable entities, so set_temperature, set_hvac_mode and turn_off on the thermostat do nothing. tests/entities.py:3345-3383 pins this as the A3(e) decision.

evidence.contention_note: shared box during fan-out; count metric, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb-available: available returns CoordinatorEntity.available alone, dropping the reading_ok term (a one-line edit in memory)

findings.metric_definition: Number of matrix cells in which the coordinator has a payload and last_update_success is True, yet HeatPumpOptimizerClimate.available is False.
findings.phenomenon_property: An entity that carries a control surface (setpoint, mode, presets) gates its whole availability on a measurement it could publish as None instead.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Drop the reading_ok term from HeatPumpOptimizerClimate.available and keep current_temperature's None gate. This overturns the A3(e) pin at tests/entities.py:3345-3383, so it needs the owner's decision.

findings.title: Climate hvac_action publishes off while an active boost runs the pump in optimizer mode off
findings.claim: With mode off and a live space or DHW boost, the actuated action has heat_pump_on=True and draws 5.0 kW space or 4.0 kW DHW, while the climate publishes hvac_action=off. This happens in all 14 such arms; the same boosts at mode auto give 0.
findings.mechanism: climate.py hvac_action returns HVACAction.OFF whenever the payload mode is off, before it reads the action. boost.apply (coordinator.py:4652) overlays live boost channels in every mode, including off, and _apply_action then switches the pump on. The pump runs while the thermostat says off.

evidence.unit: arms (RESULT hvac_action_vs_plan; 10 space-boost + 4 DHW-boost at mode off; null arm at mode auto = 0; per-step plan oracle hvac_action_steps_vs_plan=0 of 96)
evidence.contention_note: shared box during fan-out; count metric, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb-hvac-action: hvac_action returns HEATING when current_action.heat_pump_on or power_normalized > 0.1, before the mode-off check

findings.metric_definition: Number of (cell, boost channel, mode) arms in which the cycle's actuated current_action has heat_pump_on True with power+dhw_power >= 0.1 kW but HeatPumpOptimizerClimate.hvac_action is OFF or IDLE.
findings.phenomenon_property: An operating-state property derives from the mode label rather than from the action the cycle actuated.
findings.proposed_fix_scope: In hvac_action, test current_action.heat_pump_on (and the draw) before returning OFF for the mode, or return OFF only when the action says the pump is off.

findings.title: Mode actions publish a state that mixes the live mode with the stale payload mode
findings.claim: The state write a mode action makes at once carries hvac_mode=off with hvac_action=heating on the climate, and is_on=false with attribute mode='auto' on the Optimizer Active switch. This holds until the refresh has solved, 30 to 70 s on a Pi.
findings.mechanism: publish_then_refresh writes state before the refresh rebuilds coordinator.data. hvac_mode and switch.is_on read the live coordinator.mode (v6.6.12), while climate.hvac_action and OptimizerEnableSwitch.extra_state_attributes['mode'] read data['mode'], the payload copy.

evidence.contention_note: shared box during fan-out; count metric, contention-immune

perturbation.change: --perturb-live-mode: both payload-mode readers read coordinator.mode instead of data['mode']

findings.metric_definition: Number of immediate state writes made by climate.async_set_hvac_mode or OptimizerEnableSwitch.async_turn_off in which the live-mode field (hvac_mode or is_on) disagrees with a payload-mode field in the same write (hvac_action OFF-ness or the switch attribute mode).
findings.phenomenon_property: One entity state write reads the operating mode from two sources, the live coordinator.mode and the payload copy data['mode'].
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Read coordinator.mode in climate.hvac_action's off test and in OptimizerEnableSwitch's mode attribute.
